phases.name: Foundation & tracker
phases.goal: Toolchain, repo scaffold, and this progress dashboard so every later step is visible.

tasks.title: Toolchain audit (Python 3.13, Node 22, Tesseract, SQLite) and virtualenv
Game plan written as data (phases, tasks, weights)
Progress dashboard: generator, vitals scanner, page
Repo scaffold: pyproject, README skeleton, .gitignore, .env.example, git init

phases.name: MCP server core
phases.goal: A standalone FinMCP server (official mcp SDK 2.x) owning SQLite and exposing tools, resources and prompts. Milestone: works in Claude Desktop with zero frontend.

tasks.title: SQLite schema and migrations: transactions, categories, budgets, merchant memory, audit log
Typed repository layer (data access, read-only SQL guard)
Category taxonomy and realistic seed data (about 90 days, INR)
LLM provider abstraction: Anthropic SDK plus deterministic rule-based fallback
Tools: add_transaction, update_transaction, delete_transaction, list_transactions
Tool: categorize_transaction with confidence score and merchant memory
Tool: query_transactions (text-to-SQL) and run_sql (guarded SELECT)
Tool: get_summary (period, category, budget vs actual)
Resources: categories, recent transactions, monthly summaries, schema
Prompts: monthly_spending_review, categorize_uncategorized
Transports: stdio and streamable HTTP, CLI entry point
Test suite over an in-memory MCP client session
Claude Desktop milestone: config installer script and walkthrough

phases.name: Ingestion pipeline
phases.goal: Receipts, bank statement PDFs and UPI SMS become normalized transactions through one import tool that auto-categorizes.

tasks.title: Parser interface and normalized ParsedTransaction model with dedupe fingerprint
Receipt OCR: Tesseract text plus vision-LLM extraction, rule-based fallback
Bank statement parser: pdfplumber tables and CSV exports
UPI and bank SMS parser: regex library for Indian bank formats plus LLM cleanup
Tool: import_statement (parse, dedupe, insert, auto-categorize) with dry run
Synthetic fixtures (statement PDF, receipt image, SMS dump) and parser tests

phases.name: Agent layer
phases.goal: An MCP client that connects to FinMCP, holds conversation state, and lets Claude decide which tools to call.

tasks.title: MCP connection wrapper: stdio or HTTP, tool discovery, resource reads
Claude agent loop over MCP tools with conversation memory
System prompt grounded in schema and taxonomy (no hallucinated columns)
Streaming event protocol: text deltas and tool-call trace for the UI
Terminal chat REPL
Agent tests with a scripted fake model driver

phases.name: Frontend
phases.goal: FastAPI wraps the agent; a React app gives chat, upload, dashboard and an editable transaction table.

tasks.title: FastAPI backend: chat (SSE), upload, transactions, summary, categories, alerts
React + Vite + TypeScript scaffold with design tokens and typography
Chat screen with live tool-call trace
Upload screen: drag and drop, parse preview, confirm import
Dashboard: category breakdown, monthly trend, budget meters (recharts)
Transactions table with inline category edits feeding merchant memory
Production build and end-to-end smoke test

phases.name: Polish & differentiators
phases.goal: Proactive budget alerts, confidence-scored categorization with a review queue, and a reusable server anyone can plug into any MCP client.

tasks.title: Budget alerts: check_budget_alerts tool, alerts resource, agent-initiated nudges
Confidence scoring, needs-review queue, feedback learning loop
Reusable server docs: README for any MCP client, server manifest
Final QA: full test run, lint, end-to-end script, dashboard hand-off

risks.title: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the shell
risks.detail: LLM-backed tools (categorize, text-to-SQL, vision OCR, agent) run in deterministic fallback mode until a key is set in .env. Everything else works offline.

risks.title: mcp SDK 2.x API
risks.detail: FastMCP was renamed to MCPServer in mcp 2.0. Server code targets the 2.x API and pins mcp>=2.2.

risks.title: Claude Desktop config
risks.detail: The milestone installer writes to claude_desktop_config.json only when you run it. It is not touched automatically.
